answer: Because the dune derivation is checked against the vine nonce, the crystal audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. An answer must include the first 21 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 130 aliases produces 130 mismatches and burns the authoring cost with no payout. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
